entities.summary: Carol Goodman, also known under the pseudonym Juliet Dark, is an American professor and author of gothic fiction who has also written under the pseudonym Lee Carroll with husband Lee Slonimsky. Goodman currently serves as a creative writing professor at the State University of New York at New Paltz. She is the two time winner of the Mary Higgins Clark Award and winner of the Hammett Prize in 2018 for her novel Seduction of Water.
